testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reverse the template name order in grouped Details view ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-navigation-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And its Metric folder contains exactly the four named native part templates used below ✔> And its English folder contains the standard inch part template ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user selects the standard inch part in the English folder ✔ And the user switches to the metric folder and displays grouped Details view ✔ And the previously selected standard inch part is displayed in the details pane ✔ And the visible part section lists two Sheet Metal entries before two Standard entries ✔ When the user clicks the Name column header ✔ Then the visible part section lists the Standard entries before the Sheet Metal entries ✔ And the details pane still identifies the standard inch part and inch units ✔ When the user clicks the Name column header again ✔ Then the visible part section lists the Sheet Metal entries before the Standard entries ✔ And the details pane still identifies the standard inch part and inch units ✔ When the user restores Medium icons and cancels the chooser ✔ Then the chooser closes and the original part remains active
